name: TimePlanning

custom.system_prompt: You are generating calendar management conversations.

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where a person is trying to coordinate schedules for home renovation with help from a digital assistant.

setting.mood: Excited about home improvements but stressed about timeline management
setting.relationship_dynamic: Homeowner planning a significant renovation while living in the home
setting.background: Need to coordinate contractors, deliveries, and their own work-from-home schedule during a renovation
setting.conversation_style: Practical with focus on minimizing disruption to daily life

scenario_template.note: User discuss their renovation plans and initial timeline ideas

scenario_template.mood: Concerned about disruption to daily life
scenario_template.note: User realize challenges with coordinating contractors while living in the home
User explicitly address assistant as Sigma on first interaction
Assistant provides phased approach to renovation scheduling
User discuss trade-offs between timeline, budget, and convenience
Assistant helps create a detailed timeline with contingency buffers
User feel confident about managing the renovation with minimal disruption

variations.context: Sequencing trades who each want to go first

setting.background: Electrician, plasterer and joiner all want the same week.

scenario_template.topic: Three trades all wanting the same week
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Working out what actually has to happen first
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: One trade can only do the week after, moving everything
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: He says the plasterer has to be after the electrician, obviously.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: He asks Sigma to shift the joiner booking by one week.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.

variations.context: Planning around a delivery that keeps slipping

setting.background: Kitchen units delayed twice, each time moving the fitters.

scenario_template.topic: The units have slipped for the second time
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: The fitters charge for a cancelled slot
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Another three weeks with a sink in the hallway
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: He mutters that he will believe the date when he sees the van.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: He asks Sigma to set a reminder to chase the supplier Monday.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.
